'''Afrovenator men''' are [[animal people|humanoid]] versions of the [[extinct]] dinosaurs, [[afrovenator]]s, from the [[wikipedia:Jurassic|Jurassic]] era. They are roughly half the size of their afrovenator counterparts, and can appear in groups of up to 2 or 3.

Some [[dwarves]] like afrovenator for their ''graceful movement''.
